newsitem.title: USA: Air Liquide, Ball-Foster Container sign contract.
newsitem.headline: Air Liquide, Ball-Foster Container sign contract.

text.p: Air Liquide America said on Tuesday it signed a long-term agreement with Ball-Foster Container Co LLC to build and operate an air separation plant in Burlington, Wis.
Air Liquide America is part of Air Liquide Group, an industrial gas organization.

The facility will supply about 250 tons of oxygen per day to meet Ball-Foster's requirements for production of container glass. The facility would also produce 500 tons per day of liquid oxygen, nitrogen and argon to support Air Liquide's merchant customers.

"Air Liquide America's new facility represents a clear and long term commitment to our existing merchant liquid customers in Wisconsin, Illinois and Northern Indiana, as well as supporting growth of the industrial gas market in the Midwest," Bill Johnson, Air Liquide America's vice president in the midwest/northeast area, said.
Ball-Foster is 58 percent owned by Saint Gobain and 42 percent owned by Ball Corp.
